part.text:
Fixed. The root cause was that both `SneakyThrowsRemover` (src/core/lombok/bytecode/SneakyThrowsRemover.java:49) and `PreventNullAnalysisRemover` (src/core/lombok/bytecode/PreventNullAnalysisRemover.java:216) constructed the `ClassWriter` with the original `ClassReader`, which reuses the input class's constant pool — so the removed `lombok.Lombok.sneakyThrow`/`preventNullAnalysis` method refs stayed as dead constant pool entries. Switching to `new ClassWriter(0)` rebuilds the constant pool from scratch, dropping all lombok references.

Verified with `ant test.instance`: `testPostCompilerSneakyThrows` and `testPostCompilerPreventNullAnalysis` both pass, plus the 12 `TestClassFileMetaData` tests still pass.
